termsPage.title: Operating rules, mandatory partner credentials, and settlement framework.
termsPage.intro: Defines UAV PAS's role as an intermediary software platform, required legal/aviation documents for UAV providers, and milestone settlement rules.
termsPage.sec1Title: 1. Role of the UAV PAS Software Platform
termsPage.sec1Body: UAV PAS provides GIS flight planning software, airspace safety checks, telemetry monitoring, encrypted deliverable storage, and digital coordination between Clients and independent UAV Service Providers. Field flight operations are executed by verified partner operators.
termsPage.sec2Body: Before publishing listings or submitting RFQ proposals, each Service Provider must file and maintain the following verified documents in Seller Studio:
termsPage.doc1: Business Registration Certificate or legal representative government ID / Passport.
termsPage.doc2: Remote Pilot Certificate and aircraft serial / technical registration records.
termsPage.doc3: Commercial flight operation authorization / airspace permit and third-party liability insurance.
termsPage.doc4: Signed Platform Service Fee Schedule Addendum & Settlement Policy acknowledgment.
termsPage.doc5: Tax registration dossier and verified corporate/beneficiary bank account for payout reconciliation.
termsPage.sec3Title: 3. Escrow Holding, Deliverable Acceptance & Fee Schedule Addendum
termsPage.sec3Body: Client payments via EMVCo VietQR are held per mission reference. Platform coordination fees and net settlement ratios are governed formally by the Provider's executed Fee Schedule Addendum and active software tier rather than informal ad-hoc deductions. Net proceeds are disbursed to the registered beneficiary bank account once the Client confirms digital deliverable acceptance.
